::: {.callout-note}
## How to Use This Card

This is a condensed lookup card, not the normative source. Every entry below is
defined in full — with derivations, qualifiers, and sign conventions — in the
[Mathematical Notation Reference](notation.html), which remains authoritative.
Print this page (browser Print, Letter or A4) for a one-page reference while
reading the textbook series.
:::

## Control-Affine Form

$$\dot{x} = f(x) + G(x)u$$

| Symbol | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| $x$ | Modeled state |
| $f(x)$ | Drift: autonomous evolution at zero declared control |
| $G(x)u$ | Declared control-input contribution |

## Canonical Acronyms

| Acronym | Expansion |
| --- | --- |
| **ZTCF** (family) | Zero-Torque Counterfactual |
| **ZVCF** | Zero-Velocity Counterfactual |
| **DCR** | Drift-Control Ratio |
| **DgCR** | Drag-Curve Ratio |

## Core Physical Quantities

| Symbol | Quantity | Units |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $r$, $x$ | Position | m |
| $v$ | Velocity | m/s |
| $a$ | Acceleration | m/s² |
| $\omega$ | Angular velocity | rad/s |
| $\alpha$ | Angular acceleration | rad/s² |
| $m$ | Mass | kg |
| $F$ | Force | N |
| $\tau$ | Torque | N·m |
| $I$ | Moment of inertia | kg·m² |
| $p$ | Linear momentum | kg·m/s |
| $L$ | Angular momentum | kg·m²/s |

## Axis Convention

Right-handed frame, $z = x \times y$: **X** forward/longitudinal (roll), **Y**
lateral (pitch), **Z** vertical/up (yaw).
